common.blankMeaning: A dash (—) means a blank, not-yet-entered value. It is not 0.
common.traceHint: Each value carries its report field ID and the saved record it comes from.

validation.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in MAD, for example 603 or 603.50.
validation.invalidDate: That date is not valid. The default date is shown instead.

home.title: Branch operations
home.intro: Phase 2 foundation: Arabic and English screens, shared calculations on the server, and three working prototypes built on synthetic data.

prototypes.dailyClose: A month of closed days with sales, orders, average order value, card and remittance ratios.
prototypes.cashCount: A saved cash count, its reconciliation at count time, and a later bank deposit.
prototypes.comparison: One shared date pair for Maarif, Al Quds and Bourgogne, with missing figures marked.

home.modulesIntro: The structure is in place; each area is built in the phase shown.

closing.name: Daily closing
closing.description: Business days, payments, expenses, remittances, cash counts

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Product Mix, stock movements, counts, variance

dailyClose.title: Daily close
dailyClose.intro: One row per business day. A day that is not closed shows its date and blank figures.
dailyClose.totalsNote: {days} closed days included. The average is total sales divided by total orders.
dailyClose.ordersMissingNote: {days} closed days have no order count, so the average may be overstated.
dailyClose.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed. No figures are shown.
dailyClose.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.

cashCount.title: Cash count
cashCount.intro: Expected cash is the cash expected at the moment of the count. A deposit made later does not change the count result.
cashCount.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed, so there is no count to show.
cashCount.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.
cashCount.recalcOk: Recalculating at count time gives the same stored result.
cashCount.recalcDiffers: Recalculation differs from the stored result.
cashCount.noCount: No cash count was saved for this day. It is not counted, and no match is shown.

status.match: Match: the count equals the expected cash.
status.cannot_reconcile: Counted, but the expected cash cannot be calculated because opening cash, sales or card is blank.

cashCount.afterCountNote: These movements happened after the count. They change the cash in the drawer, not the count result.
cashCount.drawerAfter: Cash in the drawer after later movements
cashCount.expectedAtClose: Expected cash after all movements of the day
cashCount.previewHelp: Type a counted amount to see the result as at {time}. Leave it empty for “not counted”. 0 is a real count of zero.
cashCount.pendingBody: Who counted the cash and who was the cashier are not recorded yet. The role rules are decided in Phase 4.

comparison.title: Branch comparison
comparison.intro: One date pair is used for every branch. A branch with no figure is marked missing, never shown as 0.

ratioReason.prior_missing_or_zero: No ratio: the prior figure is missing or zero.
ratioReason.different_branches: No ratio: the two totals cover different branches.

comparison.reportingOnlyNote: Al Quds and Bourgogne figures are entered for reporting only. Maarif comes from its closed days.

reportMap.title: Report map
reportMap.intro: Every report field with its legacy cell, source record, unit, date basis, rounding, blank behavior and any open decision. Source: the reviewed Phase 1 field map.
reportMap.summary: {total} fields: {settled} agreed, {pending} waiting for a later-phase decision.
